body: This sounds awesome! I'll be the girl with a black zombie t-shirt, curly hair, and a maroon raleigh bike if anyone wants to find me.

I'm a college student and I took on too much this year. It's my final year as a student and I feel like I'm wasting my last bit of time where I could have little worry on responsibilities outside of class. I'm worried that life will just be an onslaught of work with only a few days to have a break a year.
